title: DIGOM: Disentangled Interaction Graphs for Outcome prediction in Multimodal healthcare
abstract: arXiv:2610.32451v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal healthcare data contain relational information that extends beyond individual patient observations. Effective clinical outcome prediction therefore requires not only integrating information from multiple modalities, but also modeling the relationships between them. Standard fusion approaches do not explicitly capture these interactions, while existing graph-based approaches typically model only a subset of them. We propose DIGOM (Disentangled Interaction Graphs for Outcome prediction in Multimodal healthcare), a graph-based framework that jointly models three complementary interaction types: Intra-patient cross-modal, Cross-patient same-modal, and Cross-patient cross-modal interactions. DIGOM learns a sparse multiplex graph with disentangled views, each encoding interactions between pairs of modalities across patients. Discrete adjacency matrices with patient-adaptive connectivity are sampled via a differentiable mechanism,

translated_title: DIGOM：面向多模态医疗结果预测的解耦交互图
translated_abstract: 多模态医疗数据包含着超越单个患者观测范围的关系信息。因此，有效的临床结果预测不仅需要整合来自多种模态的信息，还需要对这些模态之间的关系进行建模。标准的融合方法无法显式地捕捉这些交互，而现有的基于图的方法通常只能建模其中的一部分交互。我们提出DIGOM（Disentangled Interaction Graphs for Outcome prediction in Multimodal healthcare，面向多模态医疗结果预测的解耦交互图），这是一个基于图的框架，能够联合建模三种互补的交互类型：患者内跨模态交互、跨患者同模态交互以及跨患者跨模态交互。DIGOM学习一个具有解耦视图的稀疏多路图，其中每个视图编码患者间不同模态对之间的交互。通过可微机制采样具有患者自适应连接性的离散邻接矩阵。
tldr: 提出DIGOM框架，利用解耦视图的稀疏多路图联合建模患者内跨模态、跨患者同模态和跨患者跨模态三种交互关系，以提升多模态医疗数据的临床结果预测性能。
en_tdlr: DIGOM is a graph-based framework that jointly models three complementary interaction types (intra-patient cross-modal, cross-patient same-modal, and cross-patient cross-modal) via a sparse multiplex graph with disentangled views and differentiably sampled patient-adaptive discrete adjacency matrices, improving clinical outcome prediction from multimodal healthcare data.
